text: in the uv editor on the grid lines, give me the ability to select a grid line to be able to use it as a guide
resolution: UV grid lines can now be promoted into persistent gold authoring guides by clicking exposed line segments. Multiple guides can coexist; island, face, vertex, multi-selection, and scale drags magnetically align to guide edges/centers/points with blue latch feedback, Alt bypasses snapping, and Snap Grid > Clear Guides removes them. Guide hit-testing survives adaptive-grid changes, while drag snapping is resolved once from immutable gesture seeds to preserve dense-atlas performance.
